name: Feasibility: Partner program — Tiering
description:
Owner per PRD: Partnership team. The new 2026 tiering structure is to be implemented in the Partner Portal and launch together with it.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Onboarding guide for the program and conditions for each level
- Online test with immediate scoring
- Final approval by a Shoptet manager
- Progress bar — level progress indicator
- Meeting booking with partner manager from Silver level; lower levels see contact details only
- Online contract signing (DocuSign) — used for all signing: NDA, onboarding, add-on contracts. Confirmed as MVP scope (OQ-06)

h2. To analyse

- Where tier state and tier criteria live, and what data feeds level progress
- Test engine: build vs. buy; scoring and storage of results
- DocuSign integration — licensing, API, envelope templates, storage of signed documents
- Meeting booking — Office 365 / Outlook calendar integration feasibility
- Dependency on User management and Partner profile
